## AIDEN-001 order-service schema mismatch

Datadog logs in aiden-demo showed `@error.kind:DatabaseSchemaMismatch` (message text) on service order-service env demo. APM trace.http.request.errors spiked on POST /api/orders.

**Root cause:** Application handler expects columns customer_email and total_amount; database schema in cmd/initdb/main.go only defines amount and status.

**Mitigation:** Align initdb schema with handlers/orders.go INSERT; redeploy aiden-demo; confirm monitor clears.
